run_download_s2ef_data: run the script to download and preprocess s2ef training data for a specified split like 200k or all
run_download_is2re_data: run the script to download and organize is2re dataset into the specified data directory
run_get_data_cli: run the CLI with --task s2ef --split 2M --data-path /data to download s2ef 2M split
run_get_data_keep_intermediate: run the CLI with --keep flag to preserve intermediate files after downloading and preprocessing data
run_get_data_with_workers: run the CLI with --num-workers 4 --get-edges --ref-energy flags for parallel preprocessing with edge indices
